summary: Iteration 81 — Backend split (financial.py → sales.py/products.py/sheet_import.py) + 3 frontend features (inline approve/reject, customer profile dialog, autoPaperSize heuristic). Backend: 13/13 pytest PASS. Frontend: inline-approve-{id} and inline-reject-{id} buttons confirmed on 7 pending expenses with correct testids and visible-only-to financeAdmin gating; customer-profile-dialog opens on row click with all 3 stat cards (Total Spent / Transactions / Last Visit), Receipt History, mono-font receipt numbers, customer-receipt-{i} testids, and working 'View' button (opens /receipt/{rn} in new tab). autoPaperSize verified by code review (matchMedia heuristic with correct 80mm fallback). No backend/frontend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: [sales.py L33-40] Receipt-number generation now uses atomic db.counters.find_one_and_update({_id: sales_YYYYMMDD}, {$inc: {seq:1}}, upsert=True, return_document=AFTER). This addresses the iter80 race-window concern — concurrent POSTs on same day now get unique seq values. Good fix.
[sales.py L57-63] create_sale correctly pushes to customer_accounts.receipt_history on sale via $push — iter80 regression preserved.
[sales.py L114-130] /sales/by-receipt/{rn} correctly no-auth and scrubs created_by/cashier_id from response. Good.

[products.py L38-45] update_product recomputes stock = sum(v.stock) when has_variants AND variants provided. If caller updates has_variants=True but omits variants, stock stays unchanged (acceptable).
[sheet_import.py L29-42] Date normalizer supports DD/MM/YY and DD/MM/YYYY → ISO. Amount strip handles 'UGX', ',', ' '. Verified via pytest.

[financial.py] Router split is clean — no duplicate route registrations (grep confirmed /sales, /products, /financial/import-sheet only live in new routers). financial.py still includes /public/products but that's distinct path.

[FinancialPage.jsx L495-505] Inline approve/reject only render when e.status==='pending' AND isFinanceAdmin — correct role gating. Both use window.prompt for reason (reject) and optimistic local update + fetchAll() for consistency. Good UX.

[ProductsPage.jsx L501, L765-813] Customer rows are clickable (cursor-pointer, data-testid=customer-row) and dialog uses DialogTitle = customer name, 3 stat cards, Receipt History with customer-receipt-{i} testids and window.open(`/receipt/${encodeURIComponent(r.receipt_number)}`, '_blank'). Clean implementation.

[Receipt.jsx L22-39] autoPaperSize uses window.matchMedia('(max-width: 60mm)'), 90mm, 160mm with correct 58/80/A5/A4 fallback; final paperSize = storeSettings.receipt_paper_size || autoPaperSize || '80mm'. Safe default. Not runtime-testable in headless browser as expected.

[File sizes] financial.py is now 1003 lines (still > 700 — candidate for further split into summary/accounts/assets/balance-sheet modules). sales.py 227, products.py 154, sheet_import.py 111 — all within target.
